plan.question: Why does the config-matched magnitude intervention fail to reproduce across source versions while its unchanged-gradient control reproduces aggregate validation AUC and Logloss exactly? At seed 42, r0017-half_total_magnitude has AUC 0.6152795936767026 versus 0.6151021885074872 for r0017-half_none_bridge; r0018-magnitude_bridge falls to 0.6149066046468684 versus the same 0.6151021885074872 for r0018-none_bridge. Thus M-minus-N changes from +0.0001774051692153833 to -0.00019558386061879762, with different source hashes despite identical registered configurations. Prioritize an exact-source, common-state backward and optimizer-step audit to distinguish an intervention implementation or numerical difference from host nondeterminism, checkpoint selection, and seed-specific optimization. Uniform-energy and rotated-magnitude replacements also lose to the contemporaneous none control; these negatives do not establish recipient specificity or refute all generic-scaling mechanisms. The historical winner remains provisional until source comparability and independent-seed robustness are established.
missing_information: Authorized exact source bodies and registered configurations for both magnitude implementations and their none controls. The magnitude source hashes are 6e9e41cc4cf0e92b1036f82de88e6c214343288d1fa7de2865237d3d580106d2 and f99d3c5c88f0e705e3e0f40b245725b7ac9579e0122998d80284baab10a87f98. Current workspace exports no model or ancestor source files; receipt notes cannot establish behavioral equivalence.

An independently verified common-state comparison using identical parameters, supervised training batch, RNG state and optimizer moments: forward logits, scalar mean BCE, query/history gradient extraction, complete embedding gradients, eligible rows, projection target, magnitude ratios, finite/degenerate/padding guards, and actual parameter updates. Locate the first divergent operation or step; candidate-authored self-checks and equal scalar norms are insufficient.

Host-provided reproducibility manifests covering initialization, batch identities/order, device and numerical settings, gradient accumulation, training/checkpoint selection and exact checkpoint hashes. Equal none-control aggregate scores do not prove tensor equality or exclude intervention-specific nondeterminism. Request authorized audit evidence rather than inspect private runtime internals.

Actual Adam moment and update measurements at common states. Preserving raw-gradient direction or matching hypothetical table energy does not demonstrate matching optimizer updates. Rotation matches the unweighted scalar distribution rather than gradient energy; uniform scaling matches hypothetical same-state table energy rather than individual row magnitudes.

A later authorized audit/experiment interface and refreshed resource ledger with a bounded audit cost and protected repetition/assessment reserve. This query phase permits only retrieval-plan.json: no model edits, training, installations, other agents or withheld assessment. Any source repair must preserve failed receipts and rerun affected comparisons under the frozen protocol.

After comparability is established, authorized paired seed 43/44 validation receipts for exact frozen source versions and controls, admitted as complete comparison blocks when budget permits. Current evidence is seed 42 only; replays are not independent initializations. Authorized per-example predictions and user identities would also be required for paired user-cluster uncertainty.
